scripts.test:e2e: bun run --cwd apps/web build && playwright test
scripts.ci: bun run check && bun run check:file-length && bun run typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/web build && bun run test
scripts.dev: bun run --cwd apps/web build && bun run --cwd apps/gateway dev
scripts.deploy: bun run --cwd apps/web build && bun run --cwd apps/gateway deploy
scripts.protocol:rust: bun run scripts/generate-rust-contract.ts && cargo run -p exeora-protocol-gen
